verses.sloka: दिवम् तु तस्याम् यातायाम् शबर्याम् स्वेन तेजसा ।लक्ष्मणेन सह भ्रात्रा चिन्तयामास राघवः ॥३-७५-१॥
verses.transliteration: divam tu tasyām yātāyām śabaryām svena tejasā ।lakṣmaṇena saha bhrātrā cintayāmāsa rāghavaḥ ॥3-75-1॥

translations.english: When Sabari departed for heaven with her brilliance, Rama contemplated (about the power of sages)with Lakshmana.
translations.hindi: अरण्यकाण्ड समाप्त हुआ ॥ ` ॥ थ्री;॥ श्रासद्रासायणगुपारायगसमापनक्रमः श्रीवेषावसम्मदाय! श्रवष्णवसष्मदायः — ~ एवमेतत्पुरावृ त्तमाख्यानं भद्रमस्तु बः । प्रव्याहरत बिस्नव्धं बलं विष्णोः प्रवध ताम्‌

verses.sloka: चिंतयित्वा तु धर्मात्मा प्रभावम् तम् महात्मनाम् ।हित कारिणम् एक अग्रम् लक्ष्मणम् राघवो अब्रवीत् ॥३-७५-२॥
verses.transliteration: ciṁtayitvā tu dharmātmā prabhāvam tam mahātmanām ।hita kāriṇam eka agram lakṣmaṇam rāghavo abravīt ॥3-75-2॥

translations.english: Thinking about the power of the great sages, righteous Rama said to Lakshmana, his wellwisher with singleminded devotion:
translations.hindi: किन्तु जब उन्होंने पम्पा सरोवर को अच्छी तरह देखा, तब हर्ष में भर उनका शरीर काँ उठा और कामातुर हो, वे लक्ष्मण जी से कहने लगे

verses.sloka: दृष्टो मया आश्रमः सौम्य बहु आश्चर्यः कृतआत्मनाम् ।विश्वस्त मृग शार्दूलो नाना विहग सेवितः ॥३-७५-३॥
verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭo mayā āśramaḥ saumya bahu āścaryaḥ kṛtaātmanām ।viśvasta mṛga śārdūlo nānā vihaga sevitaḥ ॥3-75-3॥

translations.english: O handsome one, we have seen this highly wonderful hermitage, where deer and tigers dwell together with mutual confidence, where birds of all kinds inhabit.
translations.hindi: हे लद्मण ! देखो, पन्ने का तरह हर्‌ रग रौर # जल वाले इस पम्पा सरोवर झो केदी शोभा दो रही ड. । इसम तरह rT _ „ बद्योतलमद्राकुला-रमलेन्दीवसमस्सेः श्राकुशा | ( गो० ) हु तरह के कमल खिल रहे हैं और इसके चारों ओर खड़े नाना भाँति के वृक्ष इसको सुशोभित कर रहे हें

verses.sloka: सप्तानाम् च समुद्राणाम् तेषाम् तीर्थेषु लक्ष्मण ।उपस्पृष्टम् च विधिवत् पितरः च अपि तर्पिताः ॥३-७५-४॥
verses.transliteration: saptānām ca samudrāṇām teṣām tīrtheṣu lakṣmaṇa ।upaspṛṣṭam ca vidhivat pitaraḥ ca api tarpitāḥ ॥3-75-4॥

translations.english: O Lakshmana, having bathed in the waters of the seven seas (by taking ritualistic bath in these waters) the manes are offered oblations in accordance with tradition.
translations.hindi: हे लक्ष्मण । देखो. पम्पा के निकटवर्ती वनों में शङ्गयुक्त पर्वे की तरह ऊँचे ऊँचे पेड़ शोभायमान हो रहे हैं

verses.sloka: प्रणष्टम् अशुभम् यत् नः कल्याणम् समुपस्थितम् ।तेन तु एतत् प्रहृष्टम् मे मनो लक्ष्मण संप्रति ॥३-७५-५॥
verses.transliteration: praṇaṣṭam aśubham yat naḥ kalyāṇam samupasthitam ।tena tu etat prahṛṣṭam me mano lakṣmaṇa saṁprati ॥3-75-5॥

translations.english: We have got rid of inauspicious time and good days have come. Therefore, I feel truly happy. Good fortune will appear (now), O Lakshmana, O tiger among men
translations.hindi: मुझ शोकसन्तप् को वसन्त पीड़ा सी दे रहा है। एक तो भरत जी का अयोध्यापुरी के बाहिर नन्दिम्राम में रह कर ब्रतो- पबासादि कर दुःख सहन करना, दूसरा सीता का हरण । इनसे यद्यपि सें अत्यन्त पीड़ित हूँ; तथापि निर्विकार एवं शीतल जल बाली, अनेक प्रकार के पुष्पों से सुशोभित और विचित्र काननों से युक्त यह्‌ पम्पा झील मुके शोभायुक्त मालूम पड़ती हैं

verses.sloka: हृदये हि नर व्याघ्र शुभम् आविर्भविष्यति ।तत् आगच्छ गमिष्यावः पंपाम् ताम् प्रिय दर्शनाम् ॥३-७५-६॥
verses.transliteration: hṛdaye hi nara vyāghra śubham āvirbhaviṣyati ।tat āgaccha gamiṣyāvaḥ paṁpām tām priya darśanām ॥3-75-6॥

translations.english: Come, let us go to Pampa, which is pleasing to look at. Sugriva, the rigteous self, the son of the Sun has been staying for fear of Vali at the shining Rishyamuka, not far from here.
translations.hindi: देखो, ये वृक्ष जिनकी फुनगियाँ फूलों के बोझ से लदी हैं और जो स्वयं चारों ओर से फूली हुई लताओं से लिपटे हुए हैं, इ पम्प मील की शोभा बढ़ा रहे हैं.

verses.sloka: ऋष्यमूको गिरिः यत्र न अति दूरे प्रकाशते ।यस्मिन् वसति धर्मात्मा सुग्रीवो अंशुमतः सुतः ॥३-७५-७॥
verses.transliteration: ṛṣyamūko giriḥ yatra na ati dūre prakāśate ।yasmin vasati dharmātmā sugrīvo aṁśumataḥ sutaḥ ॥3-75-7॥

translations.english: Come, let us go to Pampa, which is pleasing to look at. Sugriva, the rigteous self, the son of the Sun has been staying for fear of Vali at the shining Rishyamuka, not far from here.
translations.hindi: यह पस्पा भील कमल के फूलों से ढकी हुई होने से देखने में बड़ी सुन्दर जान पड़ती हे । इसके आस पास साँप अजगर घूमा १ माधवी-वसन्तः। (गो०) २ भरदस्यदु:खेन--नगरादूब हिब्रेतोप- बासादि नियमक्रतदुःखेन | ( गो ) म सरी: ३ करते हैं और बनैले मृग आदि पशु तथा पक्षी इसके तट पर सदा भरे रहते हैं

verses.sloka: नित्यम् वालि भयात् त्रस्तः चतुर्भिः सह वानरैः ।अहम् त्वरे च तम् द्रष्टुम् सुग्रीवम् वानरर्षभम् ॥३-७५-८॥
verses.transliteration: nityam vāli bhayāt trastaḥ caturbhiḥ saha vānaraiḥ ।aham tvare ca tam draṣṭum sugrīvam vānararṣabham ॥3-75-8॥

translations.english: I am hastening to see that noble Sugriva the mighty monkey, as the search for Sita depends on him, O handsome one
translations.hindi: यह मील नीले पीले वृणों से सुशोभित है और नाना प्रकार के पुऽपां बाले बृक्षों से, जो हाथी की रंग बिरंगी झूल की तरह जान पड़ते हैं. कैसी शोभायमान दो रही है

verses.sloka: तत् अधीनम् हि मे कार्यम् सीतायाः परिमार्गणम् ।इति ब्रुवाणम् तम् वीरम् सौमित्रिः इदम् अब्रवीत् ॥३-७५-९॥
verses.transliteration: tat adhīnam hi me kāryam sītāyāḥ parimārgaṇam ।iti bruvāṇam tam vīram saumitriḥ idam abravīt ॥3-75-9॥

translations.english: To the words of Rama who was of stable mind, Lakshmana replied : My mind too is hastening me. Let us get there quickly.

verses.sloka: गच्छावः त्वरितम् तत्र मम अपि त्वरते मनः ।आश्रमात् तु ततः तस्मात् निष्क्रम्य स विशाम् पतिः ॥३-७५-१०॥
verses.transliteration: gacchāvaḥ tvaritam tatra mama api tvarate manaḥ ।āśramāt tu tataḥ tasmāt niṣkramya sa viśām patiḥ ॥3-75-10॥

translations.english: Then Rama the lord of men along with Lakshmana departed from the hermitage and went to Pampa.
translations.hindi: औ्ञनेयमसिपाटलाननं ` +° + । काञ्चनाद्रिकमनीयतिग्रहम्‌ । i पारिज्ाततरुमूलवासिनं भावयामि पवमाननन्दनम्‌।। ८ त्र सत्र रघुनाथकींतनं तत्र तत्र कृतमस्तकाञ्जलिम्‌ । बाष्पवारिपरिपूणेलोचतं मारुति नमत राज्ञसान्तकम्‌ ।! ६ ।। वेदवे परे पुंसि जाते दशरथात्मजे । वेदः प्राचितसादासीत्साक्ाट्रामायशात्मना

verses.sloka: आजगाम ततः पंपाम् लक्ष्मणेन सहप्रभुः ।समीक्षमाणः पुष्प आढ्यम् सर्वतो विपुल द्रुमम् ॥३-७५-११॥
verses.transliteration: ājagāma tataḥ paṁpām lakṣmaṇena sahaprabhuḥ ।samīkṣamāṇaḥ puṣpa āḍhyam sarvato vipula drumam ॥3-75-11॥

translations.english: He saw the sacred lake Pampa whose sweet flow of water was used by great seers. It abounded in trees and creepers. Its surface was red with lotuses at one place, white with clusters of lilies at another and with blue lotuses at other places. As such, it looked like a carpet with variegated colours.
translations.hindi: परिस्तोमै:--कुथैः । (गो०) २ प्रचुरमन्म थः-कामोद्दी पकः । (रा०) ३ गन्धवान्‌-कामोद्रोपनेनगवेवान्‌। (रा०) ४ सुरमिर्मासा-- मधुमास: (रा०} हे लक्ष्मण ! पुष्पित वृक्षों से युक्त वना का रूप तो देखो । वन के ये बृक्ष ऐसी हो पुष्पों की वर्षा कर रहे हैं, मानों बादल पानी की वर्षा कर रहे हों

verses.sloka: कोयष्टिभिः च अर्जुनकैः शत पत्रैः च कीरकैः ।एतैः च अन्यैः च बहुभिः नादितम् तत् वनम् महत् ॥३-७५-१२॥
verses.transliteration: koyaṣṭibhiḥ ca arjunakaiḥ śata patraiḥ ca kīrakaiḥ ।etaiḥ ca anyaiḥ ca bahubhiḥ nāditam tat vanam mahat ॥3-75-12॥

translations.english: He saw the sacred lake Pampa whose sweet flow of water was used by great seers. It abounded in trees and creepers. Its surface was red with lotuses at one place, white with clusters of lilies at another and with blue lotuses at other places. As such, it looked like a carpet with variegated colours.
translations.hindi: सुन्दर पत्थरों के ऊपर उगे हुए नाना प्रकार के ज्ञ पतन के झकोरों से कॉप कर, प्रथिवी के ऊपर फूलों को वपा कर रहे हैं

verses.sloka: स रामो विविधान् वृक्षान् सरांसि विविधानि च ।पश्यन् काम अभिसंतप्तो जगाम परमम् ह्रदम् ॥३-७५-१३॥
verses.transliteration: sa rāmo vividhān vṛkṣān sarāṁsi vividhāni ca ।paśyan kāma abhisaṁtapto jagāma paramam hradam ॥3-75-13॥

translations.english: Rama reached the Matanga lake which he could see from a distance and bathed in it.
translations.hindi: हे लक्ष्मण ! यह वसन्त ऋतु का वायु, इन पुष्पों के दरारा जो कुछ गिरे और कुछ गिरने को हैं ओर कुछ वृक्षा ही में लगे हैं, कैसा चारों ओर खेल सा खेल रहा हे

verses.sloka: स ताम् आसाद्य वै रामो दूरात् पानीय वाहिनीम् ।मतंग सरसम् नाम ह्रदम् समवगाहत ॥३-७५-१४॥
verses.transliteration: sa tām āsādya vai rāmo dūrāt pānīya vāhinīm ।mataṁga sarasam nāma hradam samavagāhata ॥3-75-14॥

translations.english: Lake Pampa was filled with red lotuses and their fragrance.The bank was lined with blossoming mango trees and trees of several kinds like tilaka trees with fruits full of seeds like citron, dhava trees, white trees in bloom, karavira trees loaded with flowers, punnaga trees, clusters of jasmine and kunda shrubs, fig trees, so also reeds, ashoka trees, atimuktaka creepors and several other trees looking like women adorned all over. Rama and Lakshmana passed by, glancing at them. There were other trees full of flowers, huge trees, koyashtika trees with reed. Different kinds of birds such as peacocks, parrots, dwelling in the forest were screaming aloud. Looking at all these in that forest Rama and Lakshmana passed by undisturbed with a composed mind.
translations.hindi: बायु चलने पर पुष्पां. से लदी बृच्ों की शाखाओं के साथ कूल भी हिलने लगते हें । फूलों के हिलने से उन पर वेठे हुए औरे फूलों को छोड़ गूजन लगते हैं

verses.sloka: तत्र जग्मतुः अव्यग्रौ राघवौ हि समाहितौ ।स तु शोक समाविष्टो रामो दशरथात्मजः ॥३-७५-१५॥
verses.transliteration: tatra jagmatuḥ avyagrau rāghavau hi samāhitau ।sa tu śoka samāviṣṭo rāmo daśarathātmajaḥ ॥3-75-15॥

translations.english: Lake Pampa was filled with red lotuses and their fragrance.The bank was lined with blossoming mango trees and trees of several kinds like tilaka trees with fruits full of seeds like citron, dhava trees, white trees in bloom, karavira trees loaded with flowers, punnaga trees, clusters of jasmine and kunda shrubs, fig trees, so also reeds, ashoka trees, atimuktaka creepors and several other trees looking like women adorned all over. Rama and Lakshmana passed by, glancing at them. There were other trees full of flowers, huge trees, koyashtika trees with reed. Different kinds of birds such as peacocks, parrots, dwelling in the forest were screaming aloud. Looking at all these in that forest Rama and Lakshmana passed by undisturbed with a composed mind.
translations.hindi: देखो, पहाड़ की गुफाओं से निकल कर वायु, वृक्षा को नचाता छुआ इन मतवाली कोयलों के द्वारा, मार्ना मधुर गान कर रहा है

verses.sloka: विवेश नलिनीम् रम्याम् पंकजैः च समावृताम् ।तिलकाशोकपुंनागबकुलोद्दालकाशिनीम् - यद्वा -तिलक अशोक पुन्नाग बकुल उद्दाल काशिनीम् ॥३-७५-१६॥
verses.transliteration: viveśa nalinīm ramyām paṁkajaiḥ ca samāvṛtām ।tilakāśokapuṁnāgabakuloddālakāśinīm - yadvā -tilaka aśoka punnāga bakula uddāla kāśinīm ॥3-75-16॥

translations.english: Lake Pampa was filled with red lotuses and their fragrance.The bank was lined with blossoming mango trees and trees of several kinds like tilaka trees with fruits full of seeds like citron, dhava trees, white trees in bloom, karavira trees loaded with flowers, punnaga trees, clusters of jasmine and kunda shrubs, fig trees, so also reeds, ashoka trees, atimuktaka creepors and several other trees looking like women adorned all over. Rama and Lakshmana passed by, glancing at them. There were other trees full of flowers, huge trees, koyashtika trees with reed. Different kinds of birds such as peacocks, parrots, dwelling in the forest were screaming aloud. Looking at all these in that forest Rama and Lakshmana passed by undisturbed with a composed mind.
translations.hindi: वेदवेचे षरे षुंसि जाते दशरथात्मजे । वेदः प्राचेक्तस्कदासील्साक्षाद्रामायणात्मना

verses.sloka: रम्य उपवन संबाधाम् पद्म संपीडित उदकाम् ।स्फटिक उपम तोय आढ्याम् श्लक्ष्ण वालुक संतताम् ॥३-७५-१७॥
verses.transliteration: ramya upavana saṁbādhām padma saṁpīḍita udakām ।sphaṭika upama toya āḍhyām ślakṣṇa vāluka saṁtatām ॥3-75-17॥

translations.english: Lake Pampa was filled with red lotuses and their fragrance.The bank was lined with blossoming mango trees and trees of several kinds like tilaka trees with fruits full of seeds like citron, dhava trees, white trees in bloom, karavira trees loaded with flowers, punnaga trees, clusters of jasmine and kunda shrubs, fig trees, so also reeds, ashoka trees, atimuktaka creepors and several other trees looking like women adorned all over. Rama and Lakshmana passed by, glancing at them. There were other trees full of flowers, huge trees, koyashtika trees with reed. Different kinds of birds such as peacocks, parrots, dwelling in the forest were screaming aloud. Looking at all these in that forest Rama and Lakshmana passed by undisturbed with a composed mind.
translations.hindi: यह पवन सुखस्पर्शी, चन्दन की तरह शीतल और शुद्ध गन्ध से युक्त हो, श्रम को दूर कर रहा हे

verses.sloka: मत्स्य कच्छप संबाधाम् तीरस्थ द्रुम शोभिताम् ।सखीभिः इव संयुक्ताम् लताभिः अनुवेष्टिताम् ॥३-७५-१८॥
verses.transliteration: matsya kacchapa saṁbādhām tīrastha druma śobhitām ।sakhībhiḥ iva saṁyuktām latābhiḥ anuveṣṭitām ॥3-75-18॥

translations.english: Lake Pampa was filled with red lotuses and their fragrance.The bank was lined with blossoming mango trees and trees of several kinds like tilaka trees with fruits full of seeds like citron, dhava trees, white trees in bloom, karavira trees loaded with flowers, punnaga trees, clusters of jasmine and kunda shrubs, fig trees, so also reeds, ashoka trees, atimuktaka creepors and several other trees looking like women adorned all over. Rama and Lakshmana passed by, glancing at them. There were other trees full of flowers, huge trees, koyashtika trees with reed. Different kinds of birds such as peacocks, parrots, dwelling in the forest were screaming aloud. Looking at all these in that forest Rama and Lakshmana passed by undisturbed with a composed mind.
translations.hindi: धुगन्ध युक्त बनों में वायु से मफोरी यह तरृ्षावली, भाँरों केः गुझ्नार द्वारा मानों नाद कर रही है

verses.sloka: किंनरोरगगन्धर्वयक्षराक्षससेविताम् -यद्वा - ।किन्नर उरग गन्धर्व यक्ष राक्षस सेविताम् ।नाना द्रुम लता आकीर्णाम् शीत वारि निधिम् शुभाम् ॥३-७५-१९॥
verses.transliteration: kiṁnaroragagandharvayakṣarākṣasasevitām -yadvā - ।kinnara uraga gandharva yakṣa rākṣasa sevitām ।nānā druma latā ākīrṇām śīta vāri nidhim śubhām ॥3-75-19॥

translations.english: Lake Pampa was filled with red lotuses and their fragrance.The bank was lined with blossoming mango trees and trees of several kinds like tilaka trees with fruits full of seeds like citron, dhava trees, white trees in bloom, karavira trees loaded with flowers, punnaga trees, clusters of jasmine and kunda shrubs, fig trees, so also reeds, ashoka trees, atimuktaka creepors and several other trees looking like women adorned all over. Rama and Lakshmana passed by, glancing at them. There were other trees full of flowers, huge trees, koyashtika trees with reed. Different kinds of birds such as peacocks, parrots, dwelling in the forest were screaming aloud. Looking at all these in that forest Rama and Lakshmana passed by undisturbed with a composed mind.

verses.sloka: पद्म सौगन्धिकैः ताम्राम् शुक्लाम् कुमुद मण्डलैः ।नीलाम् कुवलय उद् घाटैः बहु वर्णाम् कुथाम् इव ॥३-७५-२०॥
verses.transliteration: padma saugandhikaiḥ tāmrām śuklām kumuda maṇḍalaiḥ ।nīlām kuvalaya ud ghāṭaiḥ bahu varṇām kuthām iva ॥3-75-20॥

translations.english: Rama saw lake Pampa with cool waters and the groves on the bank filled with tilaka, ashoka, punnaga, bakula and uddala trees.
translations.hindi: सं्क्तशिखरा:--परश्परसंलिष्टाग्राः | ( गोऽ द .किष्किन्धाकाण्डे | वृक्षों की फुनगियाँ पुष्पों से ढक जाने से तथा उनके ऊपर और गुञ्जार करने से और पवन के मोकों फे लगने क कारण वृक्षा के हिलने से ऐसा जान पड़ता है, मानों पेड़ गा नाच रहे हों

verses.sloka: अरविन्द उत्पलवतीम् पद्म सौगन्धिक आयुताम् ।पुष्पित आम्र वणोपेताम् बर्हिण उद् घुष्ट नादिताम् ॥३-७५-२१॥
verses.transliteration: aravinda utpalavatīm padma saugandhika āyutām ।puṣpita āmra vaṇopetām barhiṇa ud ghuṣṭa nāditām ॥3-75-21॥

translations.english: On seeing different kinds of trees and tanks, the lovestriken Rama visited that great lake.
translations.hindi: हे लक्ष्मण ! चारों ओर खड़े इन फूले हुए कणिकार (कनेर) के पेडौ को तो देखो । मानों सुबर्ण के आभूषण पढिने हुए ओर ` पीताम्बर घारण किए हुए मनुष्य खड़े हों

verses.sloka: स ताम् दृष्ट्वा ततः पंपाम् रामः सौमित्रिणा सह ।विललाप च तेजस्वी कामात् दशरथात्मजः ॥३-७५-२२॥
verses.transliteration: sa tām dṛṣṭvā tataḥ paṁpām rāmaḥ saumitriṇā saha ।vilalāpa ca tejasvī kāmāt daśarathātmajaḥ ॥3-75-22॥

translations.english: There were lovely pleasuregardens in full bloom filled with sal and champk trees. Honeybees on flowers looked lovely and bright. The waters were crystalclear and fragrant with lotuses.The soft sands on the banks of Pampa gleamed. Rama saw them again and again and described them to Lakshmana.
translations.hindi: हे लदमण ! यह बसन्त ऋतु विविध प्रकार के पत्तियों से नादित हो, मेरे सीता-वियोग-जन्य शोक को बढ़ा रहा है

verses.sloka: तिलकैः बीज पूरैः च वटैः शुक्ल द्रुमैः तथा ।पुष्पितैः करवीरैः च पुन्नागैः च सु पुष्पितैः ॥३-७५-२३॥
verses.transliteration: tilakaiḥ bīja pūraiḥ ca vaṭaiḥ śukla drumaiḥ tathā ।puṣpitaiḥ karavīraiḥ ca punnāgaiḥ ca su puṣpitaiḥ ॥3-75-23॥

translations.english: There were lovely pleasuregardens in full bloom filled with sal and champk trees. Honeybees on flowers looked lovely and bright. The waters were crystalclear and fragrant with lotuses.The soft sands on the banks of Pampa gleamed. Rama saw them again and again and described them to Lakshmana.
translations.hindi: शोक से सन्तापित सुको यह कामदेद ओर भी अधिक सन्तप्त कर रहा है और प्रसन्न हो कूकती हुई कोयल मानों मुझे ललकार ही है

verses.sloka: मालती कुंद गुल्मैः च भण्डीरैः निचुलैः तथा ।अशोकैः सप्त पर्णैः च केतकैः अतिमुक्तकैः ॥३-७५-२४॥
verses.transliteration: mālatī kuṁda gulmaiḥ ca bhaṇḍīraiḥ niculaiḥ tathā ।aśokaiḥ sapta parṇaiḥ ca ketakaiḥ atimuktakaiḥ ॥3-75-24॥

translations.english: There were lovely pleasuregardens in full bloom filled with sal and champk trees. Honeybees on flowers looked lovely and bright. The waters were crystalclear and fragrant with lotuses.The soft sands on the banks of Pampa gleamed. Rama saw them again and again and described them to Lakshmana.
translations.hindi: देखो लक्ष्मण ! जान पड़ता है कि, सनोरस वन के मरनों के खट. पर बैठा हुआ जलकुक्कुट, हर्षित हो, अपने शब्द से मुझ कामातुर को विकल कर देगा

verses.sloka: अन्यैः च विविधैः वृक्षैः प्रमदा इव उपशोभिताम् ।अस्याः तीरे तु पूर्व उक्तः पर्वतो धातु मण्डितः ॥३-७५-२५॥
verses.transliteration: anyaiḥ ca vividhaiḥ vṛkṣaiḥ pramadā iva upaśobhitām ।asyāḥ tīre tu pūrva uktaḥ parvato dhātu maṇḍitaḥ ॥3-75-25॥

translations.english: The famous mount, sacred Rishyamuka is situated on the bank of Pampa full of blossoming trees.
translations.hindi: मेरो प्रिया सीता, आश्रम में इसकी बोलो सुन और मुझको बुला कर अत्यानदिन्त होतो थी

verses.sloka: ऋश्यमूक इति ख्यातः चित्र पुष्पित पादपः ।हरेः ऋक्षरजो नाम्नः पुत्रः तस्य महात्मनः ॥३-७५-२६॥
verses.transliteration: ṛśyamūka iti khyātaḥ citra puṣpita pādapaḥ ।hareḥ ṛkṣarajo nāmnaḥ putraḥ tasya mahātmanaḥ ॥3-75-26॥

translations.english: The mighty son of Riksharaja, the great soul, the Sun whose son was the wellknown Sugriva, resides on this mountain.
translations.hindi: ये तरह तरह के अदूभुत पत्ती भांति भाँति की बोलियाँ बोलते हुए चारों ओर से आ कर बृक्तों, -शुल्मों ओर लताओं पर गिरते हें

verses.sloka: अध्यास्ते तु महावीर्यः सुग्रीव इति विश्रुतः ।सुग्रीवम् अभिगच्छ त्वम् वानरेन्द्रम् नरर्षभ ॥३-७५-२७॥
verses.transliteration: adhyāste tu mahāvīryaḥ sugrīva iti viśrutaḥ ।sugrīvam abhigaccha tvam vānarendram nararṣabha ॥3-75-27॥

translations.english: Rama said to Lakshmana, the best of men, who had truth as his strength, Go to Sugriva, lord of the monkeys.
translations.hindi: हे लक्ष्मण ! भाँति भांति के (नर ओर मादा) पक्षियों के जोड़े अपने समुदायों में आनदिन्त हो रहे हैँ ओर देखो भ्रज्ञराज पत्ता प्रसन्न हो, कैसी प्यारी बोली बोल रहा है

verses.sloka: इति उवाच पुनः वाक्यम् लक्ष्मणम् सत्य विक्रमम् ।कथम् मया विना सीताम् शक्यम् लक्ष्मण जीवितुम् ॥३-७५-२८॥
verses.transliteration: iti uvāca punaḥ vākyam lakṣmaṇam satya vikramam ।katham mayā vinā sītām śakyam lakṣmaṇa jīvitum ॥3-75-28॥

translations.english: O Lakshmana, deprived of the kingdom I have become a destitute. With my heart attached to Sita how can I live without her ?
translations.hindi: देखो पस्पा के तट पर पक्षियों के समूह के समूह, दात्यूह पक्षी तथा नरकोयल की बोलियाँ सुन, कैसे प्रसन्न हो रहे हैं

verses.sloka: इति एवम् उक्त्वा मदन अभिपीडितःस लक्ष्मणम् वाक्यम् अनन्य चेतनः ।विवेश पंपाम् नलिनी मनो रमाम्तम् उत्तमम् शोकम् उदीरयाणः ॥३-७५-२९॥
verses.transliteration: iti evam uktvā madana abhipīḍitaḥsa lakṣmaṇam vākyam ananya cetanaḥ ।viveśa paṁpām nalinī mano ramāmtam uttamam śokam udīrayāṇaḥ ॥3-75-29॥

translations.english: Having said these words to Lakshmana who was listening to him with undivided attention, Rama, the best of the Raghus, oppressed by love and afflicted by tears of grief entered Pampa, the delightful lotuslake.

verses.sloka: क्रमेण गत्वा प्रविलोकयन् वनम्ददर्श पंपाम् शुभ दर्श काननाम् ।अनेक नाना विध पक्षि संकुलाम्विवेश रामः सह लक्ष्मणेन ॥३-७५-३०॥
verses.transliteration: krameṇa gatvā pravilokayan vanamdadarśa paṁpām śubha darśa kānanām ।aneka nānā vidha pakṣi saṁkulāmviveśa rāmaḥ saha lakṣmaṇena ॥3-75-30॥

translations.english: Thereafter, going slowly to a distance, Rama and Lakshmana saw Pampa surrounded by beautiful forests full of many varieties of birds. इत्यार्ष श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अरण्यकाण्डे पञ्चसप्ततिमस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the seventyfifth sarga of Aranyakanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
translations.hindi: हे लक्ष्मण ! यह वसन्त ऋतु रूपी आग, जिसमें लाल लाल पत्र रूपी ज्वाला उठ रही हे, मुझे मानों भस्म कर डालेगी । उस 'कमलनयनी, सुकेशी और मधुरभाषिणी को देखे बिना मेरा जीना व्यर्थं है । क्योंकि मेरी प्यारी को यदद ऋतु बहुत ही प्यारा लगता हे
